scope_description.value: Electrical engineering services for the HRSD Nansemond Treatment Plant Struvite Recovery Facility Improvements and Digester Capacity Upgrade project. BFA's documented scope includes design of six scrubber exhaust fan motor feeders (Fans 1-A, 1-B, 2-A, 2-B, 3-A, 3-B), each rated 150A at 480V three-phase, sized as 1/0 AWG copper THHN in 2-inch PVC Schedule 80 conduit with lengths ranging from 260 to 320 feet. Calculations confirm all circuits comply with the NEC 3% voltage drop limit. Specification section 26 05 19 (low voltage cable) is referenced.
